_comment: Mods in the Ascension Dev instance that the CurseForge launcher does not track (they were placed by hand), by CurseForge project and file id, so the pack's manifest can name them. The pack builder reads this next to the launcher's own record (minecraftinstance.json). Ids read from CurseForge on 2026-10-20 and 2026-10-21. Never list a mod here whose third-party distribution is off and then bundle its jar (docs/technical/pack-extras.md).

mods.name: Lootr (Forge & NeoForge)
mods.why: every player gets their own copy of a chest's loot

mods.name: Create: Simulated Thrusters
mods.why: rockets are thruster ships, helium is their fuel (ADR-0025)

mods.name: Sophisticated Core
mods.why: needed by Sophisticated Storage and Sophisticated Backpacks

mods.name: Sophisticated Storage
mods.why: chests and barrels with upgrades, so a group's base needs fewer, bigger blocks

mods.name: Sophisticated Backpacks
mods.why: a backpack, worn in Curios' back slot

mods.name: Tom's Simple Storage Mod
mods.why: one terminal for every chest; it has its own Sophisticated Storage support

mods.name: Waystones
mods.why: fast travel inside a world; pack/config/waystones-common.toml refuses any warp between worlds

mods.name: Mouse Tweaks
mods.why: drag and spread items in any inventory
